title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties:

You’ll own the delivery lifecycle end-to-end — from architecture and design to production reliability, technical mentorship, and stakeholder alignment. We’re looking for someone who can turn complex requirements into secure, scalable, high-quality software — and help the team grow in the process.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own architecture and design: create system diagrams, define functional and non-functional requirements (such as scalability, reliability, security and cost), and set integration standards.
  • Build and deliver using our technology stack (see below) with focus on quality, performance, and observability.
  • Lead initiatives: break down roadmaps, manage small to medium-sized projects, remove blockers, and ensure on-time delivery.
  • Plan and prioritize: create execution plans, estimate effort, manage risks, and clearly communicate progress to stakeholders.
  • Drive engineering excellence: enforce automated testing (unit, integration, e2e), deep code reviews, branch and release standards, and code quality.
  • Document for scale: maintain architecture documents, ADRs, operational guides, and runbooks, ensuring traceability and clarity within agile processes and tools.
  • Client interaction: attend remote and in-person meetings, capture requirements, discuss trade-offs, and present solutions clearly.
  • Mentor others: guide mid-level and junior developers, share best practices, lead tech talks, and promote a learning culture.
  • Partner management: coordinate third parties, validate deliverables, and ensure alignment with project goals.
  • Ensure production quality: validate system integrations, instrument logs, metrics, and tracing, define basic SLOs, and participate in post-mortems.
  • Continuous learning: explore new technologies, identify process improvements, and propose architectural enhancements.
  • Administrative support: handle operational requests and be available for national or international travel when required.

Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or related field.
  • Experience: 7+ years of professional experience, including technical leadership on complex projects.
  • Stack: Backend (Java, Python and .Net Core), Frontend (Angular), Node.js, SQL, strong background in REST API development, microservices and event-driven architectures.
  • Cloud: Hands-on experience with AWS or Azure, IAM (Identity and Access Management), storage, managed services and observability.
  • Quality & DevOps: Test automation, Git, Gitflow, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, semantic versioning and promotion across environments.
  • Security & Reliability: Familiarity with OWASP Top 10, secret management, least privilege, basic hardening, and observability (logs, metrics, tracing).
  • Language: Advanced English (written and spoken, client-facing).
  • Profile: Proactive, system thinker, fluent with modern frameworks and best practices in development, testing, and cloud operations.

Nice to have:

  • Postgraduate or Master’s degree.
  • Spanish proficiency.
  • IaC (Terraform) and platform engineering principles.
  • Multi-cloud experience (AWS/Azure/GCP) and cost/performance optimization.
  • Exposure to performance tuning, caching, messaging/queue systems (e.g., Kafka), and feature flag management.

A Baggio e Carvalho Engenharia é uma empresa de médio porte, especializada em gestão e execução de obras comerciais e residenciais desde 1986. A empresa vem em um ritmo de crescimento interessante nos últimos anos e está buscando pessoas para somar e crescer com ela.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Estagiário(a) de Engenharia Civil para atuar junto à equipe técnica, apoiando o(a) engenheiro(a) responsável em diversas frentes do dia a dia da obra. Procuramos alguém dinâmico(a), criativo(a) e com vontade de aprender, que goste de colocar a mão na massa e se desenvolver em um ambiente colaborativo, onde o aprendizado é constante.

Principais atividades da função:

.Apoiar o(a) engenheiro(a) da obra no acompanhamento das atividades de campo;

.Realizar levantamentos de quantitativos e auxiliar na validação de escopo de fornecedores;

.Participar de reuniões com cliente, arquiteto e gerenciadora;

.Apoiar o controle de medições e acompanhamento físico e financeiro da obra;

.Auxiliar na leitura e compatibilização de projetos;

.Contribuir com a organização de documentos e registros técnicos no drive da obra;

.Participar ativamente das rotinas de planejamento e execução, aprendendo sobre as etapas e processos construtivos.

Pré-requisitos:

.Estar cursando a partir do 7º período de Engenharia Civil;

.Conhecimento em Excel e AutoCAD (projetos 2D);

.Leitura e interpretação de projetos estruturais;

Desejável:

.Curso técnico em edificações.

Outras informações:

.Carga horária: 30h semanais (segunda a sexta-feira);

.Modalidade: Presencial;

.Local: Zona Sul do Rio de Janeiro.

title: Enfermeiro(a) foco em Auditoria In Loco PL (RJ)
description:
Você na Deloitte!

Você terá a oportunidade de evoluir sua carreira na maior organização de serviços profissionais do mundo atuando como Enfermeiro(a) com foco em Auditoria Concorrente Pleno no time de Life, Science & Health Care . Na sua rotina, você irá:

  • Atuar na região do Rio de Janeiro, em hospitais de alta complexidade, com auditoria concorrente nos prestadores credenciados tendo como objetivo realizar as adequações dos recursos e insumos dispensados ao paciente durante a permanência hospitalar;
  • Será responsável pela conciliação do faturamento pré-ajustado com a rede prestadora para redução de eventuais contestações de glosas posteriores à apresentação do faturamento hospitalar;
  • Deverá articular com o setor de autorizações da operadora para otimizar o tempo reposta das solicitações enviadas pelo hospital (e terceiros, se aplicável) e promover a desospitalização segura com inserção no serviço domiciliar quando preenchidos os critérios de elegibilidade para serviço;

  • Deverá elaborar relatórios e pareceres imparciais, realizar análise de indicadores, liderar reuniões com os prestadores e conduzir status report para corpo executivo da operadora;
  • Apoiar em algumas funções administrativas direcionadas pelo responsável do projeto em atuação.

Acreditamos na força dos talentos que preparamos. Eles transformam de fato, impactam organizações, impulsionam mais talentos e criam oportunidades. Que tal fazer parte da maior organização de serviços profissionais do mundo? Escolha seu impacto.

O que precisa para você se candidatar a vaga?

  • Graduação completa em Enfermagem;
  • Especialização em Auditoria será um diferencial;
  • Conhecimento em Pacote office;
  • Ter disponibilidade para atuar de maneira híbrida.

Beneficios

O que estará disponível para você ?

Desenvolvimento profissional

É claro que cuidaríamos do seu desenvolvimento aqui na Deloitte! Queremos que você alcance seus objetivos profissionais e pessoais e, por isso, contamos com Universidade Corporativa, acesso a plataformas online de aprendizado, plataforma de idiomas com mais de 7.500 conteúdos e cerca de 60 cursos divididos por nível, área de atuação, habilidades profissionais e interesses, e até uma plataforma que reúne diversas instituições de ensino, fornecendo descontos exclusivos para profissionais Deloitte e seus dependentes.

Além disso, oferecemos um plano de carreira estruturado, com mentoria de profissionais da Deloitte por meio de um(a) coach, que poderá ouvir seus desafios e apoiar para que consiga evoluir tanto com habilidades técnicas, quanto com habilidades comportamentais com base na própria experiência. É ótimo ter uma pessoa mentora, não é mesmo?

Cuidados com o seu bem-estar

Aqui na Deloitte, acreditamos que saúde e bem-estar não são apenas projetos, e sim uma mudança de cultura. Queremos que você coloque em prática todo o seu talento e desenvolva uma carreira de sucesso com a gente, com equilíbrio entre Mente, Corpo e Propósito. Para isso, contamos com mais de 30 benefícios, como:

  • Serviço de telemedicina para que você consiga fazer uma pré-avaliação sem precisar sair de casa!
  • Family Strategy: programa destinados à profissionais gestantes e futuros papais que terão todo apoio possível neste momento tão especial

  • Dia de folga no mês do seu aniversário, para celebrar uma das pessoas mais importantes de sua vida

title: Assistente de Sustentabilidade - Vaga exclusiva para PcD
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

  • Gerir fluxos administrativos relacionados às entregas da área, garantindo organização, priorização e acompanhamento das demandas;

  • Apoiar a automação de processos, contribuindo para aprimorar sistemas existentes, integrações e ferramentas internas, com foco em eficiência;
  • Atuar em conjunto com equipes multidisciplinares, transitando por diversas áreas da empresa para coletar informações, alinhar entregas e garantir coerência dos dados reportados;
  • Auxiliar na administração e melhoria contínua dos sistemas de monitoramento de emissões de gases de efeito estufa, identificando oportunidades de evolução;
  • Realizar análises e consolidações de dados, utilizando Excel avançado e ferramentas de BI para gerar insights que apoiem a tomada de decisão;
  • Contribuir para rotinas de governança e compliance ESG, fortalecendo a confiabilidade e rastreabilidade das informações.

Requisitos:

title: Sondador
description:
Resumo da função:

Responsável por realizar operações de perfuração e/ou intervenções de poços (workover) operando sondas, sejam elas hidráulicas ou convencionais; liderar as equipes em diversas atividades, com ou sem sonda, tais como: atividades Rig up/Rig & down (montagem e desmontagem), despressurização de poços, slick line, pescaria, wireline, dentre outras, visando pela segurança operacional, ambiental e da equipe.

Responsabilidades:

  • Conhecer e interpretar os principais dados específicos do poço (profundidade, pressão da formação, densidade do fluido de amortecimento, MAASP, etc), diagrama proposto de equipagem e o diagrama anterior para iniciar/dar continuidade as intervenções do tipo workover
  • Executar as atividades de assentamento de packer: mecânico e hidráulico, corte de cimento e tampões mecânicos (BPP e BPR) obedecendo e tendo conhecimento dos parâmetros necessários como peso sobre broca e circulação
  • Garantir a correta execução de atividades de equipagem com conjunto BCS obedecendo os cuidados necessários com a elevação das cargas para não ocorrer a flambagem, obedecendo os cuidados necessários com o manuseio e operação do cabo BCS, spooler, conectores elétricos (pig tail), instalação de clamps e alinhamento do orifício do PTS do suspensor com o adaptador A3EC
  • Executar inspeções nos equipamentos de manobra (colar de segurança, cunhas manuais e hidráulicas, elevadores de tubo, chave hidráulica) e de elevação (eslingas e cabos) bem como garantir sua integridade antes do início das operações
  • Realizar o check list diário de inspeção do sondador e garantir o correto preenchimento/inspeção dos demais check lists (torrista e plataformista) pela sua equipe orientando os demais sempre que necessário
  • Operar a sonda conhecendo os principais riscos inerentes ao tipo e a capacidade da sonda – em sonda convencional deve garantir a correta execução da tonelada milha
  • Executar e garantir a execução de todos os aspectos de segurança exigidos em atividades em área classificada, trabalho em altura, movimentação de cargas, testes hidrostáticos, H2S, equipamentos rotativos e segurança de poço
  • Planejar de forma antecipada todos os materiais e ferramentas necessários para a intervenção, bem como garantir a integridade dos equipamentos e ferramentas a bordo comunicando ao supervisor qualquer dano ocorrido
  • Garantir que a equipe siga rigorosamente o programa do poço atendendo todos os parâmetros exigidos bem como as normas vigentes de segurança operacional e de equipamentos de ESCP
  • Saber pesquisar e ter em mãos tabelas de cimentação, tabelas hidráulicas, manuais de perfurações, tabelas de tubos e revestimentos, etc.
  • Controlar todos os parâmetros operacionais do workover: peso sobre broca, densidade e viscosidade do fluido, vazão e pressão de bombeio

Exigências do Cargo:

  • Disponibilidade - Amplitude de horário – Plantão noturno - Trabalho Offshore 14x14
  • Experiência como Sondador de sondas tipo HH Drillmec e ou convencional à cabo 250.000lbs(tipo double joint/mesa rotativa) comprovados em carteira de trabalho;
  • Experiência comprovada em assentamento de tampões mecânicos e hidráulicos e obturadores (packers);
  • Experiência em equipagem de poço com coluna BCS;
  • Conhecimento teórico e prático na atividade de perfuração e/ou completação;

Escolaridade mínima:

  • Ensino médio técnico completo

Qualificação A: antes do embarque:

  • Curso Básico de Segurança de Plataforma - CBSP
  • Treinamento de Escape de Aeronave Submersa - HEUT
  • Well Control IWCF – Level 3
  • Programa de Capacitação em Segurança e Saúde no Trabalho - NR37 - Básico

title: Agile Facilitator
description:
About you

You are someone who wants to influence your own development. You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests and be able to grow professionally.

You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Computer Science or Computer Engineering or a related field.
  • Strong hands-on experience as a Scrum Master , acting as the main Agile facilitator for development teams.
  • Solid Business Analysis fundamentals , including requirements gathering, refinement, and stakeholder alignment.
  • Outstanding communication, facilitation, and negotiation skills.
  • Experience facilitating local and remote Agile teams .
  • Proven coaching and mentoring capabilities.
  • Strong background promoting Agile mindset, values, and culture .
  • Knowledge of additional Agile frameworks or methods (e.g., Kanban, XP, Lean).
  • Deep experience with refinement, story splitting, estimation, velocity tracking, retrospectives, and other Agile techniques.
  • Good understanding of software development practices such as TDD, BDD, unit testing, test automation, version control, and CI/CD.
  • Advanced English is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.

You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Act as the primary Scrum Master, ensuring Agile values, principles, and practices are consistently applied.
  • Facilitate all Scrum ceremonies and support effective team decision-making.
  • Coach and mentor Scrum teams to continuously improve delivery, collaboration, and predictability.
  • Partner with the Product Owner to support backlog refinement, prioritization, and clarity of requirements.
  • Apply Business Analysis skills to help translate business needs into clear, actionable user stories when needed.
  • Identify and remove impediments, dependencies, and delivery blockers.
  • Promote cross-team collaboration and eliminate siloed ways of working.
  • Enable data-driven continuous improvement through metrics, insights, and retrospectives.
  • Ensure goals, scope, and priorities are clearly understood across the team.
  • Support effective demos, reviews, and product/system testing activities.
  • Facilitate alignment between technical teams and business stakeholders when challenges arise.

Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.

Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*

*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

description:

title: Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer
description:
Position Summary

CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.

CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.

Essential Responsibilities

The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.

The successful candidate will:

  • Become very proficient with CMG’s software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
  • Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
  • Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
  • Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
  • Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
  • Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
  • Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.

The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.

Education

Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.

Knowledge & Skills

  • This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.
  • Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
  • Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.
  • Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.
  • Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.
  • Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software.
  • Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset.
  • Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
  • Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Brazil.
  • Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers.
  • Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.

Experience

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience is required.

No need to call us about the status of your application. We promise—we’re reviewing every submission, and if your skills are a match, you’ll hear from us!

We kindly request that external recruiters and agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles. Submissions without a signed agreement in place will not be considered and will become the property of CMG.

About Us

Innovators in Simulation Technology

CMG (TSX:CMG) is a global software and consulting company that combines science and technology with deep industry expertise to solve complex subsurface and surface challenges for the new energy industry around the world. CMG is headquartered in Calgary, AB, with offices in Houston, London, Dubai, Bogota, Rio de Janeiro, Bengaluru, and Kuala Lumpur. For more information, please visit

  • Fluently (written and speech) in Portuguese and Business-level English
  • Being able to work on companies-customized SAP application will be a differential
  • Strong negotiations skills and entrepreneurial behavior – ability to work independently.
  • Team player skills
  • Pro-active attitude
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

Na SAAM Towage Brasil estamos em busca de um(a) Analista Administrativo Júnior para nossa matriz no Rio de Janeiro

A pessoa será responsável apoiar as rotinas administrativas da matriz.

Principais funções

  • Realizar lançamentos administrativos e financeiros no sistema, incluindo: Aluguéis; Serviços contratados; Faturas de viagens;
  • Apoiar a organização e o acompanhamento dos processos de passagens aéreas e hospedagens, atendendo demandas corporativas e da diretoria;
  • Controlar e acompanhar, sob orientação, a utilização e a validade dos certificados digitais da empresa;
  • Apoiar o controle e o acompanhamento dos contratos administrativos, assegurando atualização, organização documental e suporte às áreas demandantes;
  • Solicitar e acompanhar a confecção de cartões de visita corporativos, conforme padrões institucionais;
  • Executar o controle e o acompanhamento das solicitações de recarga Veloe (combustível), conforme demandas autorizadas e políticas vigentes.
  • Apoiar o envio, controle e identificação de ativos fixos, incluindo a organização das plaquetas patrimoniais.
  • Apoiar o atendimento e o acompanhamento das solicitações de transporte corporativo, realizando interface operacional com áreas internas e fornecedores.
  • Acompanhar e manter atualizados os controles das apólices de seguros, prestando suporte administrativo às áreas envolvidas.
  • Acompanhar a execução das atividades dos prestadores de serviços terceirizados, reportando desvios ou necessidades de ajuste.
  • Executar e apoiar o inventário físico da Matriz, contribuindo para a conferência e atualização das informações patrimoniais.
  • Apoiar a administração da frota de veículos (Localiza), realizando controles operacionais, interface básica com o fornecedor e atendimento aos usuários internos.

Requisitos ⚡

  • Formação acadêmica: Ensino superior completo em Administração ou áreas afins.
  • Conhecimentos gerais: Pacote Office em nível intermediário, com ênfase em Excel.
  • Experiência: Experiência mínima de 1 ano em gestão de contratos administrativos , incluindo controle documental, acompanhamento de prazos e vigências.
  • Tipo de contrato: Indeterminado.

Candidate-se e navegue rumo a novos desafios conosco!

Reforçamos que esta oportunidade está aberta para todos(as), incentivamos à inscrição de profissionais com deficiência (PCD).

title: Data Analytics Pleno
description:
Código da vaga: 56804

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.

BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

  • Ei, profissional Analista de Dados venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!

O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

- O que você deve ter?

Linguagens e Análise de Dados

  • Python (Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Scikit-learn)
  • SQL (consultas, joins, agregações e criação de views)
  • Análise exploratória de dados
  • Noções sólidas de estatística aplicada e modelagem analítica

Big Data

Não é necessário conhecer todas as ferramentas, mas é importante ter proficiência em pelo menos uma:

  • Apache Spark (PySpark)
  • Hadoop Ecosystem (HDFS, Hive, Pig)
  • Databricks ou BigQuery

Visualização de Dados

  • Power BI ou Tableau
  • Criação de dashboards e KPIs
  • Storytelling com dados

Ambiente e Boas Práticas

  • Git / GitHub
  • Pipelines ETL / ELT
  • Documentação técnica
  • Experiência com Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP)

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Coletar, tratar e analisar grandes volumes de dados
  • Criar análises, modelos e relatórios para apoio à tomada de decisão
  • Automatizar processos utilizando Python
  • Trabalhar com processamento distribuído em ambientes Big Data
  • Desenvolver dashboards e indicadores
  • Identificar tendências e padrões relevantes
  • Atuar em parceria com áreas de negócio, traduzindo necessidades em soluções analíticas

Modelo hibrido 3x no cliente- Botafogo- RJ

CLT pela BRQ + Pacote de benefícios

- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira !

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

title: Client Services, Interpretation (Language Services | Research | Due Diligence | Remote)
description:
About Us

Cadence ( is a language services firm servicing the due diligence industry. We started in Beijing in 2014 and the types of clients we serve are expert networks, investment firms, consulting firms and market research firms. We are a remote-first company whose staff is located across multiple countries. Each individual is functionally aligned to one of three time zones (APAC, EMEA, Americas). We strive to promote internally whenever possible, so this is a limited opportunity to join a company that values ambitious and efficient professionals keen to develop their career.


Key Responsibilities

You are a project manager for our interpretation team. Your job title would be Associate on our Client Service team. The full career track associated with this role can be seen on our careers page.


You'll play a key role in ensuring clients' interpretation and market research needs are met with precision and efficiency. Your responsibilities will centre around three core areas: project management, client communication, and ad-hoc recruitment of specialized language professionals. As you master these core functions, opportunities may arise for managing more complex projects, assuming enhanced client-facing roles, and collaborating with Client Service Managers on strategic planning, furthering your growth within the Client Services team.


Our interpretation team covers both remote projects and on-site projects.


Note - this role is to manage interpretation projects, not to actually interpret on behalf of clients.



The Job


You will manage multiple projects per day.


Projects can begin and end on the same day (”I need an interpreter for a call at 8pm tonight”).


Or they can span several weeks (”I am hosting three focus groups in three Chinese cities and need moderators to facilitate the focus groups and translate the output into English”).


Here’s how you will interact with a project:


Scoping

  • You will speak with clients via email, phone, or WeChat about their needs
  • You will work with colleagues to ensure the client’s expectations for quality, speed, and cost are met
  • You will identify colleagues to assist based on the relevant time zones or regions for the project

Matchmaking

  • Your top responsibility is to identify the best linguist in our community for the client’s objective
  • You will need to present that linguists’ experience in a relevant way for the project
  • ... or you will need to recruit a new one if there isn’t an ideal match
  • You will need to constantly evaluate profitability and client satisfaction

Executing

  • You will need to sync up expectations between client(s) and linguist(s)
  • You may need to chaperone calls to ensure they begin successfully
  • You will need to speak with clients after projects to make sure they are satisfied

Key Requirements


  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field
  • Fluency in English. Fluency in an additional language is a bonus.
  • Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM systems
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and client service skills
  • Strong organizational and multitasking abilities
  • Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to work effectively in both independent and team environments
  • Goal-oriented, driven, and highly motivated to succeed & take on challenges
  • Entry-level to intermediate-level candidates are welcome to apply: any relevant work experience is a plus


Working Hours & Location


  • This is a fully-remote role where you can work from home (WFH )
  • You will work either APAC, AMER or EMEA business hours , but wherever possible, it will be your local region (eg - LatAm applicants will work AMER hours)
  • Weekends and overnights shifts are available with a commensurate increase in compensation.


Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary commensurate with experience
  • Paid time off
  • Health insurance
  • Annual allowance for professional development expenses

title: Sr. Technical Customer Success Analyst
description:
Title: Sr. Customer Support Analyst

Business Unit: Graphic Communications

Location: Brazil, Remote


Graphic Communications( a CAI Division) is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for print industries. Graphic Communications ’s integrated and automated software offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. With several offices worldwide, and over thirty-years dedicated to delivering best-in-class technology to the printing industries, it is our deeply held philosophy that Graphic Communications succeeds when our customers thrive. For more information, visit us at


As a Sr. Customer Support Analyst , you will troubleshoot complex customer requests, manage the global support queue and backlog, and ensure exceptional, timely service for our valued customers. Reporting directly to the Sr. Manager, Customer Success , you will play a crucial role in driving customer satisfaction, retention, and long-term success.

In this role, you will combine your technical expertise, analytical thinking, and customer-focused mindset to deliver high-quality solutions to critical support issues. You will act as a trusted technical advisor to customers, collaborating closely with internal teams to diagnose, resolve, and prevent recurring issues.


Your key responsibilities include delivering specialized technical solutions to escalated support cases, providing a proactive, personalized customer experience, and strengthening the partnership between the Customer Support Team and Graphic Communication’s clients through technical excellence and accountability.


Key Responsibilities

  • Answer incoming telephone calls and open cases in Salesforce, identifying customers, populating case details, and confirming data accuracy.
  • Monitor the Global Support queue and accept Salesforce cases in priority sequence.
  • Review case priority and maintain strict adherence to SLA requirements based on severity and impact.
  • Troubleshoot customer-reported issues, identify root causes, and provide timely solutions via case updates, calls, or screen-sharing sessions.
  • Provide customer support via email, Teams, and telephone using discretion, experience, and technical judgment.
  • Escalate or re-route cases to appropriate Tier 2 or Tier 3 teams after thorough investigation while maintaining SLA compliance.
  • Allocate resources, systems, and solutions to ensure efficient issue resolution.
  • Identify customers’ operational and business challenges, guiding them and the Graphic Communications team toward effective resolutions.
  • Document and submit solutions to the knowledge base with complete technical and procedural details.

title: Principal AI Engineer - AI in Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE


We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.


In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.


Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.


Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care

Automated coding and billing optimization

Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials

Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements


Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.


WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU


This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.


You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Very hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!


1. Build and Refine AI Products

Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers

Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy

Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions


2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, \"mostly right\" isn't good enough

Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products

Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy


3. Own the Development Lifecycle

Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production

Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards


4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process

Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space

In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base


REQUIRED EXPERTISE


1. Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go

Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)

Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)

Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency

Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications

Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)


2. Mindset & Approach

Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment

Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly

A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team

Possesses a \"big picture\" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing


3. Highly Valued Qualifications

Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar

Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change

Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures

Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)

Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management


Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.


WHAT WE OFFER


1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential

Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions

Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale


2. Professional Excellence

Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans

Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems

Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure

Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside


3. Work-Life Integration

Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones

Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily

Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients

Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability


READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?


If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.


Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

Easy Payroll Global Limited Ireland and their local affiliate ITOS Brasil LTDA is looking to hire a Manager, Corporate Development, to provide services to companies within the Perseus Group (“Perseus”).


Perseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.

The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. title: Human Resources Manager (Middle level)
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.

We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other
  • applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Good level of emotional intelligence
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Learning agility
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Cultural Competence
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Can-do attitude
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

title: Operations Manager
description:
Fulkrum is a global leader in inspection, expediting, auditing, and technical staffing services, delivering exceptional solutions to the energy, engineering, and construction industries for over 14 years. Headquartered in the UK, we have established a strong presence across six continents, serving more than 300 clients worldwide.

Our commitment to excellence has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise in International Trade (2023), the People and Competency Award at the EIC Awards (2023), and the Scale-Up Award at the WESCA North America Awards (2024). Most recently, Fulkrum was named the 2025 winner in the People, Culture & Optimisation category at the EIC North & Central America Regional Awards.

Our Brazil Office is currently seeking a highly motivated and experienced Operations Manager to join our dynamic team.


Main Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):

Operational Leadership

  • Efficiency and Compliance: Guide the team in operational excellence through regular training and adherence to work instructions, ensuring timely responses, accurate reporting, and proper use of the IRIS system, Integrated Management System, and all company policies, processes, and procedures. Overall responsibility for leadership and support, which enables the team and Region to meet and surpass KPIs and Quality Metrics.
  • Training and Development: Conduct initial and ongoing training for QC Coordinators (QCCs), maintaining minimal errors and supporting development. Ensure the gap analysis assessment is completed for all new starters and, as needed, for experienced coordinators.
  • IRIS Compliance: Oversee IRIS accuracy and compliance for the Region, ensuring client and inspector profiles, rates, assignments, and reports are up-to-date and meet Fulkrum standards. Operations Managers should become “super-users” of IRIS, driving continuous improvements throughout the team and the business.
  • Financial Oversight: Improve cash flow and reduce the Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC) by supporting Accounts and managing invoicing challenges between departments, reducing errors and minimising un-invoiced visits, ensuring POs and approvals are received on time, supporting credit control escalations, and reporting issues promptly and consistently to Senior Management. Identify areas for improvement between coordination and accounts, suggest process improvements, draft Corrective Action Reports (CARs), and support cash flow and credit control objectives.
  • Budget Management: Support the Regional Manager in budget maintenance, report on client activity levels, and drive financial efficiencies. Monitor and manage office expenses and personnel utilisation. Recommend improvements to the Regional Manager.
  • Gross Profit Targets: Ensure gross profit objectives by overseeing client and inspector negotiations, minimising reliance on agencies, and upholding service standards.
  • Growth and Client Engagement: Collaborate with Sales to highlight Fulkrum’s capabilities and successes, recommend growth opportunities, and support the acquisition of new clients and service lines. Present IRIS and Fulkrum’s strengths in client meetings to support business development.
  • Client Retention: Schedule reviews with key clients, addressing service quality and identifying any gaps for improvement. Maintain client relationships through regular communication and promptly address any issues to ensure satisfaction. Report concerns to the Regional Manager as needed.
  • CRM and Reporting: Document client interactions in Salesforce, compile monthly reports, and highlight successes, challenges, and key client insights for the Regional Manager.
  • Overhead Management: Regularly assess team workloads to maintain operational efficiencies, minimise redundancies, and support overhead budget goals. Propose staffing adjustments to the Regional Manager as required.


Team Development

  • Recruitment and Onboarding: Collaborate with HR to recruit and onboard new team members, ensuring resources and support are ready for a smooth start.
  • Performance and Probation Management: Lead 30-, 60-, and 90-day reviews for new hires, ensuring development aligns with company standards. Conduct regular performance evaluations and address skill gaps through targeted training.


Compliance & QHSE

  • Process Optimisation: Act as a “process expert” within Fulkrum, supporting the Integrated Management System (IMS) and continuous process improvements. Collaborate on IRIS developments and provide training for each improvement.
  • Focal Point: for QHSE and Compliance during internal/external audits, draft and implement CARs as necessary, support all IMS initiatives for process improvements.


Commercial

  • Proposal and Contract Support: Support bid preparation, draft project-specific execution plans and procedures, create/approve rate sheets, perform contract renewals, and support all other commercial requirements as needed.
  • Insurance and Compliance: Coordinate insurance documents, bank letters, and tax documentation, ensuring sufficient coverage for client projects.


Team Culture and Engagement

  • Team Building: Foster a positive and inclusive office culture, organising team events and maintaining a supportive environment. Promote retention through effective leadership and engagement initiatives.
  • Engagement: Drive any engagement survey initiatives and follow up on global, regional and local actions to ensure continuous engagement of the team.


Client Account Management

  • Client Service Reviews: Schedule meetings with key clients to evaluate service quality and implement corrective actions as necessary.
  • Business Development Support: Assist the Regional Manager and Key Account Managers in bidding, negotiating contracts, presenting to prospective clients, and identifying new business opportunities.
  • Growth and Forecasting: Monitor project forecasts, ensure proper onboarding of new clients, and communicate budget impacts to the Regional Manager and Finance Department.


Coordination Responsibilities

  • Client Support: Manage client requests for QA/QC, Engineering, and Project Support, ensuring prompt and accurate fulfilment.
  • Candidate Management: Source candidates, prepare them for interviews, and coordinate their placement, handling contractual and performance-related concerns throughout their assignments.
  • Service Level Agreements: Ensure adherence to all client SLAs and Fulkrum KPIs, negotiating inspector rates to support office margins.


Qualifications and Skills

  • Minimum 10 years of industry experience, with 5 years in a leadership role.
  • Extensive knowledge of oil and gas projects, both onshore and offshore.
  • Proficient in MS Office; CRM experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated client relationship management skills, with the ability to thrive in fast-paced environments.


Personal Attributes

  • Highly organised, process-oriented, and capable of multitasking.
  • Strong leadership skills with a proven ability to motivate and guide teams.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Willingness to support personnel and clients outside of standard hours as necessary.


Additional Information:

This is a pivotal role within the organisation, requiring exceptional interpersonal skills, keen attention to detail, and a comprehensive understanding of the oil and gas industry. The ideal candidate will be a strong team leader who consistently delivers the highest standards of service to clients. Candidates with a background in the coordination or management of large projects, a thorough knowledge of Fulkrum’s coordination and accounts processes, and a proven ability to build and nurture client relationships will excel in this position. This individual will inspire their team to meet and exceed company goals, driving both performance and growth.


Travel

Travel will frequently be required throughout the Region.


HSE Awareness:

All personnel are informed of Fulkrum’s Health and Safety policy and procedures during the onboarding process. Any HSE incidents must be reported and logged with the QHSE Manager, who will oversee and support any subsequent investigations.

Why Join Us?

This is an exciting opportunity for a driven Operations Manager to showcase their expertise in a supportive and collaborative environment. At Fulkrum, you’ll make a tangible impact while advancing your career in the thriving global business sector.


We offer a fantastic working environment with a highly engaged team and consistently high eNPS scores. Fulkrum's success in attracting new clients and expanding our global footprint is a testament to our excellence and dedication. We have regular reward and recognition initiatives, a social budget, and a refer-a-friend scheme to ensure our team feels valued and motivated.


Join us to be part of a high-performing team with ample opportunities for skill enhancement and development. Be a part of our success story and contribute to our continued growth and innovation.


Apply now and become a valued part of our growing team!

Fulkrum

description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for API Designer/Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Overview

The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.


Key Responsibilities

API Design & Development

  • Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage OpenAPI (Swagger), RAML, or AsyncAPI specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
  • API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
  • Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
  • Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
  • API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
  • Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
  • API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API DevOps framework.
  • Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
  • Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.


API Consumer Onboarding

  • Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/OpenID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
  • Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
  • Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.


Testing & Validation

  • Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
  • Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.


Skills and Expertise

  • API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using OpenAPI, SwaggerHub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
  • Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
  • Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and API key management best practices.
  • Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
  • Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman tool

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary

As a DevOps Engineer, you will make a significant contribution to infrastructure automation, continuous delivery, observability, and security by collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. The DevOps engineer evaluates emerging technologies, promotes process improvements, and shapes standards and best practices while providing expert guidance to project teams across the organization. This role plays a fundamental role in driving the adoption of cloud platform capabilities in collaboration with software engineering, architecture, and information security teams


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Deploy & Configure AWS Cloud Services;
  • Deploy & Configure Kubernetes resources;
  • Help elaborating or contributing to RFC and ADRs documents describing technical solutions;
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC) – Automate infrastructure deployment;
  • CI/CD Pipeline Automation – Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions;
  • Observability & Monitoring – Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions;
  • Disaster Recovery & Security – Develop automated backup strategies, define disaster recovery plans, and implement security best practices;
  • Workflow Automation & Integration – Build integrations to automate deployment processes, security checks, and operational workflows.



Essential Skills

  • Experience in a DevOps role, with hands-on AWS experience;
  • Experience with IaC tools, ideally Terraform and Helm Charts;
  • Experience with containerization tools (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools like CircleCI and GithubActions;
  • Experience with AWS services (EC2, S3, ECS, EKS, RDS, Lambda, VPC);
  • Knowledge of security best practices for cloud environments;
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills;
  • Familiarity with Ruby or Golang;
  • Proficiency in scripting languages (Bash, Shell, or Python).



Highly Desirable Skills

  • Networking & Security – Familiarity with DNS, Zero Trust, load balancing, IAM, firewall rules, VPNs, and cloud security best practices;
  • Monitoring & Observability – Experience using Datadog, CloudWatch;
  • Experience with Kubernetes packet managers (e.g. Helm, Kubectl);
  • AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Associate or AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate.


About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.

title: Director of Salesforce Implementation
description:
Position Overview


The Director of Salesforce Implementation will lead a team of up to 15 Salesforce professionals across the US and LATAM, including consultants, developers, administrators, solution architects, and marketing automation specialists (MCAE and MCE). This role is responsible for project delivery excellence, ensuring projects are scoped accurately, executed effectively, delivered on time, and aligned with client expectations and IMG quality standards. The ideal candidate combines deep Salesforce expertise with proven team leadership, project governance, delivery operations, and client relationship skills. This director will serve as the operational leader of the implementation team, optimizing processes, reviewing time and utilization, providing coaching, managing escalations, and driving exceptional customer satisfaction.


Key Responsibilities


Team Leadership and Management

  • Lead and mentor a cross-functional Salesforce implementation team across US and LATAM.
  • Provide coaching, one-on-ones, growth planning, and performance management.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and high-quality delivery.
  • Manage staffing, capacity planning, and resource allocation across all active projects.


Project and Delivery Oversight

  • Oversee all Salesforce implementation projects including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud Account Engagement (MCAE), Marketing Cloud Engagement (MCE), and integrations.
  • Conduct regular project reviews to ensure progress, scope alignment, and adherence to timelines.
  • Monitor time tracking, utilization, and project budgets; identify trends and address over-burn or under-delivery risks.
  • Establish and refine delivery processes, best practices, and standard operating procedures.


Quality Control and Customer Satisfaction

  • Ensure projects meet IMG quality standards and deliver measurable business value.
  • Provide strategic oversight and intervention on escalations or complex project challenges.
  • Maintain high levels of customer satisfaction through proactive communication and alignment.
  • Partner with the Sales team during handoff to ensure a smooth transition from scoping to delivery.


Operational Excellence

  • Develop and maintain predictable implementation workflows and project governance frameworks.
  • Improve reporting and tracking across project health, timelines, scope changes, and team utilization.
  • Implement delivery tools, templates, documentation standards, and internal QA processes.
  • Collaborate with leadership on forecasting, hiring needs, and Salesforce practice growth.


Cross-Department Collaboration

  • Work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, and Operations teams to ensure alignment across the client lifecycle.
  • Participate in internal strategic planning, service-offering refinement, and productization of Salesforce packages such as Jumpstart.
  • Support revenue growth by identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities during implementation.


Qualifications


Required

  • 7 or more years of Salesforce implementation experience (consulting or client-side).
  • 3 or more years leading technical or consulting teams, preferably remote or geographically distributed.
  • Strong knowledge of Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and marketing automation platforms (MCAE and MCE).
  • Proven ability to manage multiple simultaneous projects and large-scale client engagements.
  • Experience with resource planning, time tracking, utilization reporting, and delivery KPIs.
  • Strong communication, leadership, and conflict resolution skills.
  • Ability to operate at both the strategic and tactical levels.


Preferred

  • Salesforce certifications.
  • Experience at a Salesforce partner agency or professional services organization.
  • Background with project management tools such as Asana, Monday, or Wrike.
  • Experience with US, LATAM, and offshore team management.


What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and performance bonus structure.
  • Flexible remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to lead a rapidly expanding Salesforce practice.
  • Supportive leadership and a culture focused on growth, innovation, and client success.
  • Professional development opportunities and Salesforce certification support.
  • Paid time off, paid holidays, and emphasis on work-life balance.

title: MSP Delivery Specialist (Bilingual English | Portuguese)
description:
About Pinnacle Group

Pinnacle Group is a trusted leader in workforce solutions and managed service provider (MSP) operations. We partner with enterprise clients to streamline contingent workforce management, strengthen supplier relationships, and ensure program compliance. Our mission is to deliver operational excellence through technology-driven solutions, industry expertise, and exceptional service quality across all facets of workforce delivery.


Summary

Pinnacle Group is seeking an MSP Delivery Specialist to manage the full life cycle of contingent workforce requests. This role serves as a key point of contact for client hiring managers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders, ensuring seamless requisition management, compliance, and operational success. The ideal candidate has strong experience in recruitment, MSP operations, and Vendor Management Systems (VMS), combined with a customer service mindset and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.


Job Description

  • Train, assist, and facilitate the requisition life cycle with client hiring managers and suppliers.
  • Support large-scale hiring initiatives, VMS data integrity projects, and supplier rationalization efforts.
  • Conduct intake calls, qualify candidate resumes, and manage requisition flow from posting through fulfillment.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with hiring managers, suppliers, and internal program teams to ensure program success.
  • Maintain a service-focused approach, delivering a high-quality experience to all stakeholders.
  • Utilize and provide training on MSP tool such as Beeline and applications including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • Ensure timely and accurate submission of required documentation by suppliers, maintaining adherence to SLAs and KPIs.
  • Support reporting, analytics, and client-specific initiatives as assigned.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience, preferably in a business-related field.
  • 3–5 years of experience in MSP operations, or contingent workforce management .
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and experience with Beeline
  • Bilingual Competency across English and Portuguese
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex concepts clearly.
  • Proven success in a client-facing, fast-paced, and service-oriented environment.
  • Self-starter who can work independently and exercise sound judgment in ambiguous situations.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities with a solution-driven mindset.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy under tight deadlines.


Why Join Pinnacle Group?

At Pinnacle Group, you’ll play a vital role in advancing workforce solutions that power some of the world’s leading organizations. We foster a collaborative environment that encourages innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth. You’ll have the opportunity to strengthen your MSP expertise, build strategic relationships, and make a meaningful impact in a company that values excellence and accountability.


Compensation and Benefits Disclosure

The specific compensation for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role as well as the cost of labor in the market; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. Our full-time consultants have access to benefits including medical, dental, vision and 401K contributions as well as any other PTO, sick leave, and other benefits mandated by appliable state or localities where you reside or work.
